tasks.label: sync
tasks.detail: Python: install the locked dependencies into .venv.

tasks.label: format: verify
tasks.detail: Python: the same formatting gate CI runs.

tasks.label: format: fix
tasks.detail: Python: apply formatting and the lint fixes ruff can make.
tasks.command: uv run ruff format && uv run ruff check --fix

tasks.label: security: bandit
tasks.detail: Python: bandit over src, as CI runs it.

tasks.label: security: audit
tasks.detail: Python: pip-audit over the locked dependencies; needs network and a bash-compatible shell.
tasks.command: uv run pip-audit -r <(uv export --locked --format requirements-txt --no-emit-project --quiet) --disable-pip --progress-spinner off

tasks.label: typecheck
tasks.detail: Python: mypy in strict mode over src and tests.

tasks.label: test
tasks.detail: Python: run the tests in parallel.

tasks.label: test: file
tasks.detail: Python inner loop: run one file, class, or test, stopping at the first failure.

tasks.label: coverage
tasks.detail: Python: run tests with branch coverage; the HTML report is in htmlcov/. CI fails below 90% line or 85% branch.

tasks.label: web: build
tasks.detail: Web: typecheck and build the production bundle.

tasks.label: web: check
tasks.detail: Web: typecheck, lint, style, format, and unit tests.

tasks.label: web: e2e
tasks.detail: Web: Playwright end-to-end tests (needs: npx playwright install chromium).

tasks.label: verify: all
tasks.detail: Everything CI runs for Python and the web client, in order.

tasks.label: docs: lint markdown
tasks.detail: Lint every Markdown file, as the Docs job does.

tasks.label: docs: check links
tasks.detail: Check links and anchors between files.

tasks.label: clean
tasks.detail: Remove environments, caches, and build output for a cold run.
tasks.command: rm -rf .venv .pytest_cache .mypy_cache .ruff_cache .hypothesis .coverage* htmlcov coverage.json coverage.xml dist build web/node_modules web/dist web/.cache web/playwright-report web/test-results
